description: This is a PHP source file defining the Zend_Loader_Autoloader class, which implements an autoloading stack and namespace-specific autoloading mechanisms for the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader
classes.description: Implements a singleton autoloader stack and namespace autoloaders for the Zend Framework, handling class loading and namespace registration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the autoloader.

methods.name: resetInstance
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance, allowing reinitialization.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Static method to autoload a class by invoking registered autoloaders.

methods.name: setDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Sets the default callback used for autoloading classes.

methods.name: getDefaultAutoloader
methods.description: Retrieves the current default autoloader callback.

methods.name: setAutoloaders
methods.description: Sets multiple autoloaders at once.

methods.name: getAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns the current list of autoloaders.

methods.name: getNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Returns the autoloaders registered for a specific namespace.

methods.name: registerNamespace
methods.description: Registers a namespace for autoloading.

methods.name: unregisterNamespace
methods.description: Unregisters a namespace from autoloading.

methods.name: getRegisteredNamespaces
methods.description: Returns all registered namespace autoloaders.

methods.name: setZfPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the Zend Framework library, optionally specifying version.

methods.name: getZfPath
methods.description: Retrieves the current Zend Framework library path.

methods.name: suppressNotFoundWarnings
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to suppress warnings when classes are not found.

methods.name: setFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Configures whether the autoloader acts as a fallback.

methods.name: isFallbackAutoloader
methods.description: Checks if the autoloader is set as a fallback.

methods.name: getClassAutoloaders
methods.description: Retrieves autoloaders associated with a specific class's namespace.

methods.name: unshiftAutoloader
methods.description: Prepends an autoloader to the autoload stack, optionally for specific namespaces.

methods.name: pushAutoloader
methods.description: Appends an autoloader to the autoload stack, optionally for specific namespaces.

methods.name: removeAutoloader
methods.description: Removes an autoloader callback from the stack, optionally for specific namespaces.

methods.name: _autoload
methods.description: Internal implementation of the autoload function called during class loading.

methods.name: _setNamespaceAutoloaders
methods.description: Sets autoloaders for a given namespace internally.

methods.name: _getVersionPath
methods.description: Determines the filesystem path for a specific Zend Framework version.

methods.name: _getVersionType
methods.description: Determines the type of version string provided ('latest', 'major', 'minor', 'specific').

methods.name: _getAvailableVersions
methods.description: Returns available Zend Framework versions from the specified directory.
